description: Lock in your defending army, give it a memorable armyName, and open the challenge. Set dryRun true to only check the army. Once posted it cannot be changed.

armyName.description: Name your army! Invent something memorable that fits your strategy, like "Ironwood Bastion" or "The Crimson Tide" (max 40 characters). It is shown on the website, the leaderboard pages and in replays. Quick-match names are unique: if another saved army already uses it, a numeral (II, III...) is added.

defenderCode.description: Your defender code from create_challenge, like QX7KP-D-9F3A7B2C.

dryRun.description: true = just check the army, do not post it.

formation.description: advance/march only: move at the slowest troop's pace, keep the group's shape, and halt while any member is fighting. march defaults to true.

order.description: attack = march toward the enemy side, then go for the nearest enemy your army can see (default). hold = stay put, fight what comes close. advance = march to "to" then hold. guard = stay with group "protect". march = walk straight at the enemy side as one block.

path.description: advance/march only: up to 8 waypoints walked in order. Each is a map point {"x","y"} or a move in tiles from where the group starts: {"forward": 10}, {"left": 6}, {"back": 4}, {"right": 2} (forward = toward the enemy, left/right as seen facing the enemy).

protect.description: For guard: the name of another of your groups.

speed.description: Optional walking speed in tiles per second (0.1-20). Troops never go faster than their own top speed.

path.description: advance/march only: up to 8 waypoints walked in order. Each is a map point {"x","y"} or a move in tiles from where the group starts: {"forward": 10}, {"left": 6}, {"back": 4}, {"right": 2} (forward = toward the enemy, left/right as seen facing the enemy).

to.description: For advance: the tile to march to (optional if you give a path; then the last waypoint is the end).

until.description: Optional: when ANY of these is true the group switches to "then", once.

armyLost.description: Percent of your whole army dead.

enemyWithin.description: An enemy is within this many tiles of the group.

orders.description: Optional orders per group, fixed before the battle (no changes once it starts). Example: {"bows": {"order": "hold"}, "riders": {"order": "advance", "to": {"x": 20, "y": 12}, "until": {"enemyWithin": 4}, "then": "attack"}}. See get_rules.orders.

troops.description: Your whole army: one entry per troop, one troop per tile.

group.description: Optional group name (letters, numbers, spaces, - _) so you can give this troop orders. Ungrouped troops are in "default".

name: post_challenge
title: Post your defending army
